seo.title: Setu Tuition — Coaching Class Management Software
seo.description: Setu Tuition is coaching class management software for attendance, fees, parent messaging and results, built for tuition teachers in India. Coming soon.

hero.headline: Tuition Class Management Software for Teachers
hero.subheadline: Attendance, fees, parent communication and results for the class you take yourself — built around one teacher and their students, not an office full of staff.

body.headline: What we're building
paragraphs: The free Tuition Class Manager already runs a class end to end in the browser — students, batches, daily attendance, monthly fees, receipts and test results, entirely offline and without a login. Setu Tuition is what comes next when the browser itself becomes the limit.

Automated WhatsApp reminders that go out on their own instead of one tap per parent, a parent view that always shows the live fee and attendance position instead of a snapshot, online fee collection that reconciles itself against the right month, and your class synced across your phone, tablet and laptop rather than living in one browser.
It stays a single teacher's tool. Staff rosters, teacher attendance and salary management belong to a different kind of product, and we are deliberately not building this into one.

cta.headline: Want early access to Setu Tuition?
cta.subtext: Tell us about your class and we'll notify you as soon as Setu Tuition launches.

crossSell.text: You don't have to wait — the free Tuition Class Manager works today, offline and without signup.
